name: Notion Calendar

surfaces.surface_type: main window — week view (from marketing composite; only the app window is design evidence)
failures: #9 colored event-label text on same-hue pastel fill likely <4.5:1 (amber/yellow 'Santiago work trip!' worst)
#10 right-panel hairline dividers ~8-12% black, below the 3:1 UI-contrast floor
#14 no focused element shown in static render — focus appearance unverifiable
native#1 web-electron (custom hollow traffic lights + inline keycaps), not AppKit-native
native#3 today = red solid square, selection = neutral grey capsule — not the inset-rounded accent-fill grammar
native#6 functional accent hardcoded red, not bound to controlAccentColor
native#10 custom hollow-ring traffic-light dots (HIG-named non-native mistake)

tokens.notes: today badge + urgency; NOT the user system accent

tokens.value: neutral grey rounded capsule, no accent tint
pastel tint ~12-18% sat body + ~3px saturated left rail + hue-matched label
neutral grotesque, reads as system stack (SF Pro / -apple-system)
tokens.notes: cannot confirm SF vs Inter at render scale

patterns.key_values: custom title strip (not NSToolbar): avatar + 'Week' pull-down + 'Today' push button + prev/next chevrons; ~28-30px controls; no single glass group
left ~160-170px warm-grey rail = mini month calendar; today red square, current-week grey capsule, out-of-month dimmed, month nav chevrons
right ~205-215px white panel: search field + 3 labeled sentence-case sections (No upcoming meeting / Scheduling snippet / Quick meeting) with inline S/F keycaps
week grid with dual-timezone (EST/PST) gutter+header, all-day band, colored event chips; black now-line + dot
event-chip state vocabulary: solid=confirmed, hatched left rail=tentative, dashed outline=proposed, strikethrough=declined, grey=holiday

signature_moves: Status-as-edge-treatment event chips: one chip vocabulary encodes 5 meeting states (confirmed/tentative/proposed/declined/holiday) via fill, hatched rail, dashed outline, and strikethrough — no status icons needed
Keyboard-first keycap chips (S, F) inline beside actions — Superhuman-lineage command identity taught in place
Dual-timezone gutter (EST/PST side-by-side) promoted into the layout skeleton
Two-weight month title ('January' black + '2024' grey) — de-emphasis inside one string
Red-as-today hardcoded (calendar-page metaphor), deliberately not the system accent; selection stays neutral grey so red always means 'now'
defects: Custom traffic-light dots — hollow grey rings, HIG-named non-native mistake; native fix = real NSWindow dots that fill on focus
Accent not bound to system — today/urgency hardcoded red instead of controlAccentColor
Contrast Dilution (risk) — hue-matched saturated event-label text on same-hue pastel fill; amber/yellow likely <4.5:1
Faint dividers — ~8-12% black hairlines below the 3:1 UI-contrast floor and native ~29% separator

aesthetic.direction: Neo-grotesque product (Linear/Vercel family): near-white neutral ramp, hairline borders, bold sans headings, one restrained functional color (red), dense-calm grid with generous whitespace

psychology: Von Restorff — single red 'today' marker + one quiet-fill 'Share availability' CTA pop against an otherwise neutral field; red reserved so it always signals 'now'
Jakob's Law — conventional week-grid calendar users already know; innovation spent on the product (scheduling snippets, keycaps), not the layout
Hick's / performance load — inline keycap hints let power users bypass pointer travel, cutting decision+motor cost
Miller/Cowan chunking — right panel groups meeting actions into 3 labeled chunks
Aesthetic-usability — high polish buys first-contact trust for a scheduling tool
notes: Marketing composite, not a raw screenshot: only the bottom app window is design evidence; the wordmark, tagline, and floating cat/coffee/bike sticker-icons are brand evidence, kept separate. Window rendered downscaled (~0.85x of 1:1) and bottom-cropped, so ALL pixel values are estimated with wide ranges and absolute pt sizes are inferred. Single surface only — no settings/empty-state/dark-mode/onboarding evidence. An icon.webp exists in sources but was NOT digested (task scoped to Workflow A / UI only). Lineage web-electron => contrast evidence, excluded from macOS canon; record as tells+corrections. Font family could not be confirmed (SF Pro vs Inter) at this scale.
